builtBy: pnpm fetch-club-rosters (scripts/fetch-club-rosters.mjs): the public team rosters of ECNL Girls Northern Cal and ECNL Regional League Girls NorCal, read through each league's own Schedules & Standings page in a local Chromium. clubSlugs is kept by hand.
notes: A kept copy of the public team rosters of ECNL Girls Northern Cal and the ECNL Regional League's NorCal girls division, the GU14 through GU18/19 age groups, so a high school roster can be compared with them the day it is posted (pnpm compare-club-rosters) without reading the leagues' pages again. Never rendered: it names players who are on no tracked roster.

Read through each league's own Schedules & Standings page (app.athleteone.com) in a local Chromium: the division's standings for its teams, then each team's page, whose Roster button lists the players. The class year is in the data the team page loads and is not printed on the Roster dialog. The same data refuses a request that does not come from the page.

Kept per player: name, position, class year and the roster's label (First Team Player, Club Player Pool, Discovery Player, Guest Player). Not kept: staff, jersey numbers, account ids, a player a team hides from its public roster (counted in `hidden`) and a player too young to be in high school this season, which is a class year after 2030 or, on a GU14 team, no class year (counted in `tooYoung`).

clubSlugs maps a league club id to its record in clubs.json and is kept by hand: the 12 member clubs with a record in San Francisco, the Peninsula, the South Bay and Santa Cruz County, plus Mustang Soccer (East Bay) and Marin FC, each there because a player is tied to it. The other clubs of the two leagues are compared but never linked.
A player on two of a club's teams is listed on both. 3 Regional League teams showed no player on 2026-11-22 (Santa Clara Sporting's G2011/12 and Valley Surf's G2010/11 and G2009/10).
